caribbean.headline: St. Maarten Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten is experiencing 23 kt winds, 5.9 ft waves, 88% rain probability, and I expect heavy rainfall to continue through the afternoon. Antigua remains calm with 0 kt winds, and I will monitor for any changes.

mediterranean.headline: Haifa Faces Moderate Winds, 5.8-Ft Waves Today
mediterranean.paragraph: I observe Haifa experiencing winds up to 13 kt and waves reaching 5.8 ft, with 38% rain probability, while the dominant swell direction is WNW. I note that Mykonos remains calm with 0 kt winds and negligible swell, presenting a safe passage for vessels.
